caption: Each parameter gets its own type; the return type goes after the parameter list's closing parenthesis.
The compiler can usually infer a simple return type on its own — annotating it is optional, but common on exported functions for clarity.

code:
function connect(url: string, timeoutMs?: number) { /* ... */ }
function connect(url: string, timeoutMs: number = 5000) { /* ... */ }
caption: A ? makes a parameter optional (may be undefined). A default value makes it optional too, and fills it in when omitted.
A function type describes the parameter types and return type a callback must match — caught at the call site, not at runtime.
